subject: Recap & MAP: Solstice - pilot priorities, stakeholders, and decision timeline
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dana Wu <dana.wu@solsticehealth.ai>, Alex Romero <alex.r@solsticehealth.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2026 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Recap & MAP: Solstice - pilot priorities, stakeholders, and decision timeline

Hi Dana / Alex —

Thanks again for the conversation earlier. Quick recap + proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) based on what we discussed so we’re aligned on next steps. I put the high level items below and attached a working MAP spreadsheet for dates/stakeholders.

Top pain points you shared
- Latency and throughput spikes when running batch inference on existing infra (especially during end-of-day processing).
- Higher than-expected per-token costs across ensemble heuristics; manual sharding is brittle.
- Need for tighter observability for token-level cost breakdowns and audit logs for compliance.

Goals for the pilot
1) Demonstrate consistent sub-150ms median latency on a 2k context for the primary clinical summarization model.
2) Reduce tokenized cost by >=25% vs current baseline through batching, KV caching, and quantized model runs.
3) Validate security posture (VPC + audit logging) and confirm we can meet your SOC-like evidence needs.

Proposed MAP (attached spreadsheet has fields filled) — milestone / owner / target date
- Pilot contract & SOW signed / Alex (Procurement) + Kimberly (Sales) / target: 2026-07-23
- Dedicated pilot capacity provisioned (2x A100 equiv) / Redwood infra (Vivek) / target: 2026-07-30
- Data onboarding & sample workload run (dev env) / Solstice MLOps (Dana) + Redwood infra / target: 2026-08-04
- Baseline measurement & tuning pass (latency/cost) / Redwood Eng (Marcus) + Solstice MLOps / target: 2026-08-11
- Security evidence handoff (config, logs, certs) / Solstice Sec + Redwood Sec / target: 2026-08-14
- Executive review & decision (go/no-go for production) / Solstice Execs + Kimberly / target: 2026-08-21

Stakeholders we noted during the call
- Dana Wu — Head of MLOps (technical owner; will drive onboarding)
- Alex Romero — Procurement lead (contracts + PO timing)
- Dr. Priya Menon — Clinical compliance reviewer (in loop post-security pass)
- Marcus Lin — Redwood technical lead for the pilot (will run tuning sessions)
- Vivek Kulkarni — Redwood infra lead (will own capacity & VPC setup)

Open questions we need your confirmation on
1) Who will sign the SOW (legal contact + PO timing)?
2) What sample dataset(s) can we use for the initial baseline run? Any privacy redactions required?
3) Does Solstice require an on-prem package for the pilot or will VPC-hosted dedicated capacity suffice?

Immediate next steps (ask)
- Can you confirm the SOW signer and approximate PO timeline by EOD Thursday (2026-07-15)?
- Please review the attached MAP and drop dates/comments inline in the spreadsheet; I’ll incorporate and send updated version.

Happy to join a short 20-min follow-up if that helps accelerate procurement.

Thanks,

Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0163

Attachments: Solstice_MAP_v1.xlsx, Security_QA_2026-07.pdf
From: Dana Wu <dana.wu@solsticehealth.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Romero <alex.r@solsticehealth.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2026 17:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap & MAP: Solstice - pilot priorities, stakeholders, and decision timeline

Thanks Kimberly — this looks great and mirrors what we discussed. A few clarifications:
- Procurement: Alex will confirm whether Legal or Procurement signs SOW; earliest PO window is late next week (7/22–7/23).
- Data: We can provide a de-identified sample (1000 records) for the baseline run. I’ll send the dataset link by 7/14; it needs a short privacy attestation.
- On-prem vs VPC: for the pilot, VPC-hosted dedicated capacity is fine; we’ll revisit on-prem for production.

I’ve left two comments on row 4 of the MAP (SOW signatory / PO date). Also attaching the Solstice security questionnaire PDF — highlights at a glance: we need token-level audit examples and a network diagram.

Appreciate the clear timelines — we’re aligned on 8/21 exec review.

Best,
Dana
Dana Wu
Head of MLOps | Solstice Health
dana.wu@solsticehealth.ai | +1 (617) 555-2219

Subject: Fwd: Recap & MAP: Solstice - pilot priorities, stakeholders, and decision timeline

Vivek / Marcus — forwarding the MAP and Dana’s quick confirmation. Two asks for the infra/tuning side:
1) Vivek — can you confirm capacity estimate (2x A100 equiv) + expected lead time to provision in their preferred AWS region? If you can flag any networking docs we should send (VPC flow, peering options), I’ll include them in the packet to Solstice.
2) Marcus — once Viva’s estimate is in, can your team run a quick feasibility plan for the 2k context 150ms median target? A short runbook with tuning levers (kv cache, batch sizes, tokenization options) is ideal.

I’ve attached the MAP v1 that I’ll update with dates once we get the procurement signal.

Thanks —
Kimberly

Subject: Re: Recap & MAP: Solstice - pilot priorities, stakeholders, and decision timeline

Kimberly / team — quick update from infra: we can provision a 2x A100-equivalent pool in us-west-2 within 5 business days after SOW sign + initial payment. Network docs (VPC peering guide + required security group rules) attached here: I will drop them into the Drive link you referenced.

Marcus — I’ll sync with you this afternoon on tuning constraints (memory v. batch tradeoffs) — early estimate: batching + prefix KV caching should get you most of the way to the 25% cost reduction target without quantization for pilot; quantized run can be a follow-up once baseline numbers are captured.

Vivek
